name: Simon Paluck
bio: Simon Paluck is a Canadian actor, writer and producer.

credits.title: Priyanka! What's My Name?
credits.overview: After hitting a breaking point, drag superstar Priyanka is forced to reevaluate her life, identity, and relationships.

credits.title: Insta Gay
credits.overview: A millennial reels after breaking-up with a popular gay influencer. Insta Gay is a drama-comedy that explores the real world impact that vapid gay social media has on the queer community.

credits.title: Sissy
credits.overview: An intimate exploration of a child and father navigating grief through gender expression.

credits.title: Sunny Side Up
credits.overview: After receiving a corneal transplant, a man befriends a witty blue-haired girl at the park.

credits.title: Chalk Dust
credits.overview: Through a series of elaborate chalk drawings, a girl who is deaf is able to hear again.
